questions.q: What does the answer_correctness metric measure?
options: How closely the agent's final response matches the expected ground-truth answer
How many tools the agent called during the run
How fast the agent responded, in seconds
Whether the agent's warehouse was the right size
questions.explain: Answer correctness closes the loop from actions back to the user's goal by comparing the final response to a ground-truth answer.

questions.q: What's the difference between tool_selection_accuracy and tool_execution_accuracy?
options: Selection checks whether the right tools were called at all; execution checks whether each called tool got the right input and returned acceptable output
They measure the same thing — selection is just the older name
Selection only applies to Cortex Search; execution only applies to Cortex Analyst
Selection measures cost; execution measures latency
questions.explain: Tool selection accuracy covers whether the orchestration layer invoked the expected tools; tool execution accuracy covers whether each tool call's input/output met requirements.

questions.q: What does a metric "version" (like v1, v2, v3) pin down?
options: The judge model, prompt, rubric, and thresholds behind a score, so results stay reproducible run over run
Which Snowflake edition the account is on
The warehouse size used to run the evaluation
The number of ground-truth questions in the dataset
questions.explain: A version pins the judge model together with the prompt, rubric, and thresholds, so the same trace scores consistently from one run to the next.

questions.q: Which SQL function starts, checks, cancels, or deletes an evaluation run?
options: EXECUTE_AI_EVALUATION
RUN_CORTEX_EVAL
CREATE EVALUATION POLICY
AI_EVALUATE
questions.explain: EXECUTE_AI_EVALUATION takes an action ('START', 'STATUS', 'CANCEL', 'DELETE') plus a run name and a config file path on a stage.

questions.q: According to this lesson, which metric is reference-free — meaning it doesn't require a ground-truth answer to score a run?
options: logical_consistency
answer_correctness
tool_execution_accuracy
None of the four system metrics are reference-free
questions.explain: logical_consistency checks whether the agent's instructions, planning, and tool calls hang together internally, without comparing against a ground-truth answer.
